summary: This clinical trial compares an AI-assisted lifestyle program, a drug called tirzepatide, and standard lifestyle care for adults with obesity and newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes, which is a condition where the body cannot properly process sugar. The study looks at how these approaches affect body weight and blood sugar control over 52 weeks. A total of 285 participants aged 18 to 65 years will take part in the research. The trial is sponsored by The First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University.
